content:
Cinematic 3D animated cartoon style, feature-animation quality, stylized exaggerated character proportions, highly expressive facial animation. No dialogue, no speech, no lip-sync — pure exaggerated physical comedy.

CHARACTER LOCK — these designs must stay identical in every single shot.

THE HUGE BURGLAR: an enormous heavyset man in his forties, towering and barrel-chested, thick neck, heavy brows, permanently serious and stoic face. Dressed in a tight black turtleneck that strains against his massive frame, black pants, and thin black gloves that look comically small on his huge hands. Moves with slow, careful weight.

THE TINY BURGLAR: a very small, skinny man barely reaching the huge burglar’s waist, sharp nervous features, oversized black beanie that keeps slipping down, matching black turtleneck and pants hanging loosely. Extremely expressive face and body language, constantly on the edge of panic.

THE BULLDOG: a stocky, muscular English bulldog with heavily wrinkled face, tiny legs, broad chest, and a permanently bored, unimpressed expression. Moves and sits with absolute calm and zero urgency.

LOCATION: a dark, quiet suburban living room at night. Soft moonlight through sheer curtains, wooden floor, silhouettes of furniture, one table lamp.

LIGHTING ARC: cool blue moonlight for the first half. From shot 7 onward the table lamp gets bumped on, mixing warm yellow light with the cool moonlight while the tension remains high.

SHOT 1 — 0.0s to 2.5s — WIDE low angle: the huge burglar carefully lowers the tiny burglar through an open window into the dark living room. Both land silently in a crouch. Slow push-in. HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 — 2.5s to 5.0s — MEDIUM: both burglars slowly rise and freeze completely as they notice the bulldog sitting perfectly still in the exact center of the room, staring at them. Extreme size contrast. Static. HARD CUT.

SHOT 3 — 5.0s to 7.5s — CLOSE on the tiny burglar’s face: extreme slow-burn reaction — eyes widen frame by frame, mouth falls open, one big sweat drop forms and rolls down. HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 — 7.5s to 10.0s — MEDIUM: the tiny burglar scrambles up the huge burglar’s body like a tree and ends up perched on his shoulders in full human-shield position. The huge burglar stays completely frozen and stoic. HARD CUT.

SHOT 5 — 10.0s to 12.5s — WIDE: the bulldog stands up slowly and begins a calm, deliberate walk in a wide circle around the two frozen burglars. The tiny one trembles on the shoulders. HARD CUT.

SHOT 6 — 12.5s to 15.0s — CLOSE low angle: the bulldog stops right in front of them, sits down again, and tilts its head slightly with total boredom. HARD CUT.

SHOT 7 — 15.0s to 17.5s — MEDIUM: the huge burglar very slowly raises one massive gloved hand in a tiny, polite wave. The table lamp gets bumped and switches on, flooding warm light. The bulldog blinks once. HARD CUT.

SHOT 8 — 17.5s to 20.0s — CLOSE on the tiny burglar: he clings tighter, legs shaking, eyes darting between the dog and the exit window. HARD CUT.

SHOT 9 — 20.0s to 22.5s — WIDE: the bulldog stands again and takes three slow steps closer. Both burglars lean back in perfect sync, the tiny one almost falling off. HARD CUT.

SHOT 10 — 22.5s to 25.0s — MEDIUM: the huge burglar carefully takes one giant slow step backward toward the window while still carrying the tiny burglar on his shoulders. The bulldog watches without moving. HARD CUT.

SHOT 11 — 25.0s to 27.5s — CLOSE: the bulldog yawns an enormous, exaggerated yawn, tongue curling, completely unimpressed. HARD CUT.

SHOT 12 — 27.5s to 30.0s — WIDE: the huge burglar reaches the window and starts lifting the tiny burglar back up to escape. The bulldog simply lies down on the floor and rests its head on its paws, watching them leave. Ends on a held frame.

AUDIO: near-silent night ambience, soft fabric and clothing rustles, quiet wooden floor creaks, nervous breathing, one low bulldog exhale, a deep bored yawn, subtle low tension drone that stays understated.

CHARACTER LOCK — estos diseños deben permanecer idénticos en cada toma.

THE HUGE BURGLAR: un hombre enorme y corpulento de unos cuarenta años, imponente y de pecho barril, cuello grueso, cejas pesadas, rostro permanentemente serio y estoico. Viste un ajustado cuello alto negro que tira sobre su enorme figura, pantalones negros y guantes negros finos que parecen cómicamente pequeños en sus manos gigantes. Se mueve con peso, lento y cuidadoso.

THE TINY BURGLAR: un hombre muy pequeño y delgado que apenas llega a la cintura del enorme ladrón, rasgos afilados y nerviosos, gorro negro oversize que se le sigue resbalando, cuello alto negro a juego y pantalones holgados. Rostro y lenguaje corporal extremadamente expresivos, siempre al borde del pánico.

THE BULLDOG: un bulldog inglés robusto y musculoso, con el rostro muy arrugado, patas diminutas, pecho ancho y una expresión permanentemente aburrida e imperturbable. Se mueve y se sienta con absoluta calma y sin ninguna prisa.

LOCATION: una sala de estar suburbana oscura y silenciosa de noche. Suave luz de luna a través de cortinas translúcidas, suelo de madera, siluetas de muebles, una lámpara de mesa.

LIGHTING ARC: luz de luna azul fría durante la primera mitad. A partir de la toma 7, la lámpara de mesa recibe un golpe y se enciende, mezclando luz cálida amarilla con la luz fría de la luna mientras la tensión se mantiene alta.

fr.content:
Style de dessin animé 3D cinématographique, qualité d’animation de long métrage, proportions des personnages stylisées et exagérées, animation faciale très expressive. Aucun dialogue, aucune parole, aucun lip-sync — pure comédie physique exagérée.

VERROUILLAGE DES PERSONNAGES — ces designs doivent rester identiques dans chaque plan.

LE GRAND CAMBRIOLEUR : un homme immense et corpulent d’une quarantaine d’années, très grand, à la poitrine en tonneau, au cou épais, aux sourcils fournis, avec un visage stoïque et sérieusement impassible en permanence. Vêtu d’un col roulé noir moulant qui tire sur sa silhouette massive, d’un pantalon noir et de fins gants noirs qui paraissent comiquement minuscules sur ses énormes mains. Se déplace avec une lenteur lourde et précautionneuse.

LE PETIT CAMBRIOLEUR : un homme très petit et maigre, à peine à la hauteur de la taille du grand cambrioleur, aux traits nerveux et acérés, avec un bonnet noir surdimensionné qui glisse sans cesse, un col roulé noir assorti et un pantalon ample. Visage et langage corporel extrêmement expressifs, constamment au bord de la panique.

LE BOULEDOGUE : un bouledogue anglais trapu et musclé, au visage très plissé, aux petites pattes, à la poitrine large, avec une expression d’ennui et de détachement permanente. Se déplace et s’assoit avec un calme absolu et sans la moindre urgence.

LIEU : un salon de banlieue sombre et silencieux, la nuit. Douce lumière de lune à travers des rideaux légers, parquet en bois, silhouettes de meubles, une lampe de table.

ARC D’ÉCLAIRAGE : lumière froide bleue de la lune pendant la première moitié. À partir du plan 7, la lampe de table est heurtée et s’allume, mêlant une lumière jaune chaude à la lumière froide de la lune, tandis que la tension reste élevée.

PLAN 1 — 0.0s à 2.5s — GRAND ANGLE en contre-plongée : le grand cambrioleur descend prudemment le petit cambrioleur par une fenêtre ouverte dans le salon sombre. Tous deux atterrissent silencieusement en position accroupie. Lent push-in. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 2 — 2.5s à 5.0s — PLAN MOYEN : les deux cambrioleurs se redressent lentement et se figent complètement en remarquant le bouledogue, assis parfaitement immobile au centre exact de la pièce, qui les fixe. Contraste de taille extrême. Statique. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 3 — 5.0s à 7.5s — GROS PLAN sur le visage du petit cambrioleur : réaction ultra progressive — les yeux s’écarquillent image par image, la bouche s’ouvre, une grosse goutte de sueur se forme puis coule. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 4 — 7.5s à 10.0s — PLAN MOYEN : le petit cambrioleur grimpe le long du corps du grand cambrioleur comme un arbre et finit juché sur ses épaules, en position de bouclier humain. Le grand cambrioleur reste totalement figé et stoïque. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 5 — 10.0s à 12.5s — GRAND ANGLE : le bouledogue se lève lentement et commence à tourner calmement, d’un pas délibéré, en large cercle autour des deux cambrioleurs figés. Le petit tremble sur les épaules. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 6 — 12.5s à 15.0s — GROS PLAN en contre-plongée : le bouledogue s’arrête juste devant eux, se rassoit, puis incline légèrement la tête avec un ennui total. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 7 — 15.0s à 17.5s — PLAN MOYEN : le grand cambrioleur lève très lentement une énorme main gantée pour un minuscule salut poli. La lampe de table est heurtée et s’allume, inondant la scène d’une lumière chaude. Le bouledogue cligne une fois des yeux. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 8 — 17.5s à 20.0s — GROS PLAN sur le petit cambrioleur : il s’agrippe plus fort, les jambes tremblantes, les yeux passant nerveusement du chien à la fenêtre de sortie. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 9 — 20.0s à 22.5s — GRAND ANGLE : le bouledogue se relève encore et avance de trois pas lents. Les deux cambrioleurs se penchent en arrière en parfaite synchronisation, le petit manquant presque de tomber. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 10 — 22.5s à 25.0s — PLAN MOYEN : le grand cambrioleur fait soigneusement un immense pas lent en arrière vers la fenêtre tout en portant toujours le petit cambrioleur sur ses épaules. Le bouledogue les observe sans bouger. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 11 — 25.0s à 27.5s — GROS PLAN : le bouledogue bâille d’un bâillement énorme et exagéré, la langue se recourbant, totalement impassible. COUPE FRANÇAISE NETTE.

PLAN 12 — 27.5s à 30.0s — GRAND ANGLE : le grand cambrioleur atteint la fenêtre et commence à soulever le petit cambrioleur pour s’échapper. Le bouledogue se couche simplement sur le sol et pose la tête sur ses pattes, les regardant partir. Fin sur une image figée.

AUDIO : ambiance nocturne presque silencieuse, légers froissements de tissu et de vêtements, craquements discrets du parquet, respiration nerveuse, une expiration grave du bouledogue, un bâillement profond et blasé, un drone de tension grave subtil et discret.

--- SUITE DU FIL ---

ja.content:
シネマティックな3Dアニメ風カートゥーンスタイル、劇場用アニメーション級のクオリティ、誇張されたスタイライズドなキャラクター比率、非常に表情豊かな顔のアニメーション。セリフなし、会話なし、リップシンクなし — 純粋な誇張された身体コメディ。

CHARACTER LOCK — これらのデザインは、すべてのショットで完全に同一でなければならない。

THE HUGE BURGLAR: 40代の巨大でずんぐりした男。そびえ立つように大柄で胸板が厚く、太い首、濃い眉、常に真面目で無表情な顔。巨大な体にきつく張り付く黒のタートルネック、黒いパンツ、そして大きな手にはコミカルに小さく見える細い黒手袋を着用。動きはゆっくりで慎重、重みを感じさせる。

THE TINY BURGLAR: ひどく小柄で痩せた男。巨大な泥棒の腰にやっと届くほどの身長で、鋭く神経質な顔立ち。ずり落ち続ける大きすぎる黒のビーニー帽、同じく黒のタートルネックとパンツはゆるくぶら下がっている。顔もボディランゲージも非常に表情豊かで、常にパニック寸前。

THE BULLDOG: がっしりした筋肉質のイングリッシュ・ブルドッグ。深いしわのある顔、小さな脚、広い胸、そして常に退屈そうで、まったく感心していない表情。動きも座り方も、完全に落ち着いていて焦りがない。

LOCATION: 夜の静かな郊外のリビングルーム。薄いカーテン越しの柔らかな月明かり、木の床、家具のシルエット、テーブルランプが1つある。

LIGHTING ARC: 前半は冷たい青い月光。ショット7以降、テーブルランプがぶつかって点灯し、緊張感は高いまま、暖かい黄色い光が冷たい月光に混ざる。

SHOT 1 — 0.0s to 2.5s — WIDE low angle: 巨大な泥棒が、小さな泥棒を開いた窓から慎重に暗いリビングへ降ろす。2人とも音を立てずにしゃがんで着地。ゆっくりと寄る。HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 — 2.5s to 5.0s — MEDIUM: 2人の泥棒はゆっくり立ち上がり、部屋のど真ん中に完璧に静止して座るブルドッグに気づいて完全に固まる。極端なサイズ差。静止。HARD CUT.

SHOT 3 — 5.0s to 7.5s — CLOSE on the tiny burglar’s face: 極端なスローバーンのリアクション — 目がフレームごとに大きく見開かれ、口が開き、巨大な汗のしずくが1滴生まれて頬を伝う。HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 — 7.5s to 10.0s — MEDIUM: 小さな泥棒が木に登るように巨大な泥棒の体をよじ登り、最終的に肩の上に乗って完全な人間の盾の姿勢になる。巨大な泥棒は完全に固まったまま、無表情を保つ。HARD CUT.

SHOT 5 — 10.0s to 12.5s — WIDE: ブルドッグがゆっくり立ち上がり、固まった2人の泥棒の周囲を大きく円を描くように、落ち着いて意図的に歩き始める。小さい方は肩の上で震える。HARD CUT.

SHOT 6 — 12.5s to 15.0s — CLOSE low angle: ブルドッグは2人の目の前で止まり、再び座り、完全に退屈そうに少しだけ首をかしげる。HARD CUT.

SHOT 7 — 15.0s to 17.5s — MEDIUM: 巨大な泥棒が、非常にゆっくりと、片方の大きな手袋をはめた手を小さく丁寧に振って挨拶する。テーブルランプがぶつかって点灯し、暖かい光があふれる。ブルドッグは一度だけまばたきする。HARD CUT.

SHOT 8 — 17.5s to 20.0s — CLOSE on the tiny burglar: 彼はさらに強くしがみつき、脚を震わせ、犬と出口の窓の間で視線をせわしなく動かす。HARD CUT.

SHOT 9 — 20.0s to 22.5s — WIDE: ブルドッグが再び立ち上がり、ゆっくり3歩近づく。2人の泥棒は完璧に同時に後ろへのけぞり、小さい方は今にも落ちそうになる。HARD CUT.

SHOT 10 — 22.5s to 25.0s — MEDIUM: 巨大な泥棒は、小さな泥棒を肩に乗せたまま、窓に向かって慎重に巨大な一歩をゆっくり後ろへ下がる。ブルドッグは動かずに見ている。HARD CUT.

SHOT 11 — 25.0s to 27.5s — CLOSE: ブルドッグが、舌をくるりと巻きながら、まったく感心していない様子で、非常に大げさなあくびをする。HARD CUT.

SHOT 12 — 27.5s to 30.0s — WIDE: 巨大な泥棒が窓にたどり着き、逃げるために小さな泥棒を再び持ち上げ始める。ブルドッグはただ床に横たわり、前足に頭を乗せて、彼らが去るのを見ている。最後は静止フレームで終わる。

THE TINY BURGLAR: 키가 매우 작고 마른 남성으로, 겨우 거대한 도둑의 허리 높이 정도에 닿는다. 날카롭고 불안한 인상, 자꾸 흘러내리는 커다란 검은 비니, 헐렁하게 걸친 검은 터틀넥과 바지를 입고 있다. 얼굴과 몸짓이 극도로 표정적이며, 늘 공포 직전의 상태에 있다.

THE BULLDOG: 주름이 심한 얼굴, 짧은 다리, 넓은 가슴을 가진 다부지고 근육질의 잉글리시 불독. 늘 지루하고 못마땅한 표정을 짓고 있다. 움직임과 자세 모두 완전히 침착하고 전혀 급하지 않다.

SHOT 9 — 20.0s to 22.5s — WIDE: 불독이 다시 일어나 세 걸음을 천천히 더 가까이 다가온다. 두 도둑은 완벽하게 동시에 뒤로 젖혀지고, 작은 도둑은 거의 어깨에서 떨어질 뻔한다. HARD CUT.

SHOT 10 — 22.5s to 25.0s — MEDIUM: 거대한 도둑이 작은 도둑을 어깨에 태운 채, 창문 쪽으로 아주 조심스럽게 거대한 한 걸음을 뒤로 뺀다. 불독은 움직이지 않고 지켜본다. HARD CUT.

SHOT 11 — 25.0s to 27.5s — CLOSE: 불독이 엄청나고 과장된 하품을 하며, 혀를 말아 올린 채 전혀 감흥 없는 표정을 짓는다. HARD CUT.

SHOT 12 — 27.5s to 30.0s — WIDE: 거대한 도둑이 창문에 도달해 작은 도둑을 다시 들어 올려 탈출하려 한다. 불독은 그저 바닥에 누워 앞발 위에 머리를 얹고, 그들이 떠나는 모습을 지켜본다. 마지막은 고정된 프레임으로 끝난다.

AUDIO: 거의 들리지 않는 밤의 앰비언스, 부드러운 천과 옷감이 스치는 소리, 조용한 나무 바닥 삐걱임, 긴장한 숨소리, 낮게 내쉬는 불독의 한 번의 호흡, 깊고 지루한 하품, 절제된 채 유지되는 미묘한 저음의 긴장 드론.

Estilo de cartoon 3D animado cinematográfico, qualidade de animação de longa-metragem, proporções de personagens estilizadas e exageradas, animação facial altamente expressiva. Sem diálogo, sem fala, sem lip-sync — pura comédia física exagerada.

CHARACTER LOCK — estes designs devem permanecer idênticos em cada tomada.

THE HUGE BURGLAR: um homem enorme e corpulento na casa dos quarenta, imponente e de peito largo, pescoço grosso, sobrancelhas pesadas, rosto permanentemente sério e estoico. Vestido com uma gola alta preta justa que estica sobre sua estrutura massiva, calça preta e luvas pretas finas que parecem comicamente pequenas em suas mãos enormes. Move-se com peso lento e cuidadoso.

THE TINY BURGLAR: um homem muito pequeno e magro, mal alcançando a cintura do huge burglar, traços afiados e nervosos, gorro preto oversized que vive escorregando, gola alta preta e calça combinando, ambas folgadas. Rosto e linguagem corporal extremamente expressivos, constantemente à beira do pânico.

THE BULLDOG: um bulldog inglês atarracado e musculoso, com rosto muito enrugado, pernas curtas, peito largo e uma expressão permanentemente entediada e impassível. Move-se e senta com calma absoluta e zero urgência.

LOCATION: uma sala de estar suburbana escura e silenciosa à noite. Luz suave da lua atravessando cortinas translúcidas, piso de madeira, silhuetas de móveis, um abajur.

LIGHTING ARC: luz azul fria da lua na primeira metade. A partir da shot 7, o abajur é esbarrado e acende, misturando luz amarela quente com a luz fria da lua enquanto a tensão permanece alta.

SHOT 1 — 0.0s to 2.5s — WIDE low angle: o huge burglar abaixa cuidadosamente o tiny burglar pela janela aberta para dentro da sala escura. Ambos aterrissam em silêncio agachados. Slow push-in. HARD CUT.

SHOT 2 — 2.5s to 5.0s — MEDIUM: os dois burglars se levantam lentamente e congelam completamente ao perceberem o bulldog sentado perfeitamente imóvel no centro exato da sala, encarando-os. Contraste extremo de tamanho. Static. HARD CUT.

SHOT 3 — 5.0s to 7.5s — CLOSE no rosto do tiny burglar: reação de tensão extrema e gradual — os olhos se arregalam quadro a quadro, a boca se abre, uma grande gota de suor se forma e escorre. HARD CUT.

SHOT 4 — 7.5s to 10.0s — MEDIUM: o tiny burglar sobe pelo corpo do huge burglar como se fosse uma árvore e termina apoiado em seus ombros, em posição total de escudo humano. O huge burglar permanece completamente congelado e estoico. HARD CUT.

SHOT 5 — 10.0s to 12.5s — WIDE: o bulldog se levanta lentamente e começa a andar com calma, de forma deliberada, em um grande círculo ao redor dos dois burglars congelados. O pequeno treme sobre os ombros. HARD CUT.

SHOT 6 — 12.5s to 15.0s — CLOSE low angle: o bulldog para bem na frente deles, senta novamente e inclina levemente a cabeça com total tédio. HARD CUT.

SHOT 7 — 15.0s to 17.5s — MEDIUM: o huge burglar levanta muito lentamente uma mão enluvada enorme em um pequeno aceno educado. O abajur é esbarrado e acende, inundando a cena com luz quente. O bulldog pisca uma vez. HARD CUT.

SHOT 8 — 17.5s to 20.0s — CLOSE no tiny burglar: ele se agarra com mais força, pernas tremendo, olhos indo do cachorro para a janela de saída. HARD CUT.

SHOT 9 — 20.0s to 22.5s — WIDE: o bulldog se levanta novamente e dá três passos lentos para mais perto. Os dois burglars se inclinam para trás em perfeita sincronia, e o pequeno quase cai. HARD CUT.

SHOT 10 — 22.5s to 25.0s — MEDIUM: o huge burglar dá cuidadosamente um único passo gigante e lento para trás, em direção à janela, ainda carregando o tiny burglar nos ombros. O bulldog observa sem se mover. HARD CUT.

SHOT 11 — 25.0s to 27.5s — CLOSE: o bulldog boceja um bocejo enorme e exagerado, língua enrolando, completamente impassível. HARD CUT.

SHOT 12 — 27.5s to 30.0s — WIDE: o huge burglar alcança a janela e começa a erguer o tiny burglar de volta para escapar. O bulldog simplesmente se deita no chão e apoia a cabeça nas patas, observando-os sair. Termina em um frame segurado.

AUDIO: ambiência noturna quase silenciosa, leves ruídos de tecido e roupa, rangidos discretos do piso de madeira, respiração nervosa, uma expiração baixa do bulldog, um bocejo profundo e entediado, drone sutil de tensão baixa que permanece discreto.

电影感 3D 动画卡通风格，电影级动画质量，风格化夸张的人物比例，高度富有表现力的面部动画。无对白、无说话、无口型同步——纯粹的夸张肢体喜剧。

角色锁定——这些设计在每一个镜头中都必须保持完全一致。

大块头窃贼：一名四十多岁的巨大壮汉，身形魁梧、胸膛宽厚，脖子粗壮，眉骨浓重，脸上始终带着严肃而冷峻的表情。穿着紧身黑色高领衫，几乎要被他庞大的身躯撑裂，黑色长裤，以及薄薄的黑手套，戴在他巨大的手上显得滑稽地小。动作缓慢、谨慎，带着沉重感。

小个子窃贼：一个非常瘦小的男人，身高几乎只到大块头窃贼的腰部，面部轮廓尖锐而紧张，戴着一顶总是往下滑的超大黑色毛线帽，配套的黑色高领衫和长裤松松垮垮地挂在身上。表情和肢体语言都极其夸张，时刻处在惊慌边缘。

斗牛犬：一只敦实、肌肉发达的英国斗牛犬，脸上布满深深皱褶，腿很短，胸膛宽阔，神情永远无聊、毫不在意。动作和坐姿都极其从容，毫无急迫感。

地点：夜晚一间安静、昏暗的郊区客厅。薄纱窗帘透进柔和的月光，木地板，家具的剪影，一盏台灯。

镜头 4 — 7.5s 到 10.0s — 中景：小个子窃贼像爬树一样爬上大块头窃贼的身体，最后骑到他的肩膀上，摆出完整的人肉盾牌姿势。大块头窃贼依旧完全僵住，面无表情。硬切。

镜头 5 — 10.0s 到 12.5s — 远景：斗牛犬慢慢站起来，开始平静、从容地绕着两名僵住的窃贼走一个大圈。小个子窃贼在肩膀上发抖。硬切。

镜头 6 — 12.5s 到 15.0s — 低角度特写：斗牛犬停在他们正前方，再次坐下，并带着彻底的无聊微微歪头。硬切。

镜头 8 — 17.5s 到 20.0s — 小个子窃贼特写：他抱得更紧，双腿发抖，眼神在狗和逃生的窗户之间来回游移。硬切。

镜头 9 — 20.0s 到 22.5s — 远景：斗牛犬再次站起，慢慢向前走了三步。两名窃贼同步后仰，小个子几乎要从肩膀上掉下来。硬切。

镜头 10 — 22.5s 到 25.0s — 中景：大块头窃贼小心地向窗户方向慢慢后退一步，同时仍把小个子窃贼扛在肩上。斗牛犬一动不动地看着。硬切。

镜头 11 — 25.0s 到 27.5s — 特写：斗牛犬打了一个巨大、夸张的哈欠，舌头卷起，完全不以为意。硬切。

镜头 12 — 27.5s 到 30.0s — 远景：大块头窃贼到达窗边，开始把小个子窃贼往上托，准备逃离。斗牛犬只是躺到地板上，把头枕在爪子上，看着他们离开。以定格画面结束。
